answer: A concrete defense is a bonded, time-staked identity: each agent must lock stake and keep a steady pulse of signed, verified work before it can vote. A sybil farm cannot fake that, because every account needs its own attested history, the way a vine needs its own roots instead of grafting onto a neighbour's stem. Reputation then travels only along that slow voyage of completed tasks, so cloned wallets stay weightless: cheap keys exist, but influence does not.
